summary.tpReason: Four successful password credentials were added to four separate applications by VadimJ. Three were created through Azure CLI/Python SDK in a batch-like pattern, and no approval, source IP, or corresponding VadimJ sign-in is available to establish this as authorized provisioning. This creates application-authentication persistence if VadimJ was unauthorized.
summary.fpReason: The telemetry contains no direct compromise indicator: audit source IPs are blank, no VadimJ sign-ins or related Office events were retained, and there are no corroborating alerts. The application names are generic and the Azure CLI/Python SDK plus a Purview-labelled secret are compatible with administrator/developer provisioning; authorization cannot be determined from the data.
summary.whatHappened: At 2026-08-19 18:01:05Z, the scheduled rule alerted that VadimJ@buildseccxpninja.onmicrosoft.com added credentials to EntApp01-EntApp04. Directory audit records confirm four successful 'Update application – Certificates and secrets management' events: EntApp01 received password credential PurviewAppAccess (ID 1714a3cf-c8dc-40e6-bc2a-fdfaf55baf42) via Edge; EntApp02 received Key 3 (8c123b9d-31e6-4f50-a21f-88eabc8857e5), EntApp03 Secret (bd3aa4f4-0737-42be-8506-1d2378a2ff0b), and EntApp04 Secret (a9d6190a-ee00-45ba-9975-4fa0b00bd4f4), all via Python 3.8/Azure CLI 2.27.0. Audit records report no initiating IP. No evidence shows subsequent use of these credentials.
keyEvidence: Directory audit confirms all four credential-add operations succeeded; each changed KeyDescription from [] to a Password/Verify credential on EntApp01-EntApp04.
EntApp02-04 were modified with the same Python 3.8 / azure-graphrbac / Azure CLI 2.27.0 user agent, consistent with scripted or command-line batch activity.
EntApp01 was modified through Edge and named PurviewAppAccess, whereas the other three added generic/blank-labelled secrets; this mixed activity requires owner validation.
The only other app-credential alert at the same alert-generation time involved a different actor (Victim) and purview-spn-user099; it does not corroborate compromise of VadimJ.
